ui_bugs.issue: my-products-commission-note is only rendered when items.length > 0 (conditional). On empty state (VIP with no products) the 5% commission notice is hidden - user won't see the commission rule before creating their first product. Consider showing it above the create button unconditionally.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' inside movement-product native <select>. Likely the option renders a nested span (e.g., stock badge). Use plain text in <option>.
Several shadcn DialogContent instances are missing DialogDescription or aria-describedby (accessibility warning) - appears on movement dialog, my-product dialog, vendor-reject dialog.

action_items: Move my-products-commission-note out of the items.length > 0 conditional so VIP users see the 5% commission rule even before creating their first product.
Fix hydration warning in InventoryMovementsTab movement-product <select>: options must not contain <span>; render label as plain text like `${name} (stock ${n})`.
Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby={undefined} suppression is not correct) to shadcn Dialogs used in movements, my-products and vendor-reject to fix a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: InventoryDashboardTab: `useEffect(() => { load(start, end); }, [])` disables exhaustive-deps but is fine here; however if start/end props ever change externally the initial fetch would be stale — acceptable but noted.
InventoryControlTab.load() swallows errors silently (`.catch(() => {})`) making auth/permission failures invisible to users. Consider surfacing errors via toast.
MyProductsView commission note gating by items.length > 0 is a UX regression against spec ('Commission note visible').

success_rate.frontend: 100% of 5 requested flows pass; 1 minor UX issue + 2 a11y/hydration warnings
